notes: The function (constants included) and relation symbols occurring in the formula, with kind and arity; equality and bottom are logical and never members.
The sentence obtained by substituting fresh pairwise distinct constants for the free variables of either formula; not a complement.

role: signature expanded by the fresh constants for free variables
notes: The union of the two compatible signatures together with the pairwise distinct fresh constants c_1 to c_k; distinct from the P2 tableau signature with a star.

role: bound-variable renaming of a formula away from a finite variable set
notes: Alpha-equivalent to the input with the same free variables and vocabulary; local to the annex proof. Distinct from the P8 da Costa consistency operator.

role: replacement of a constant by a variable
notes: Replaces every occurrence of the constant c by v and leaves every quantifier unchanged; used only when v does not occur in the formula. Distinct from capture-avoiding substitution [t/x].
The L(P)-structure with the domain and L-interpretations of an L(P,P')-structure N, interpreting P as P' is interpreted in N.

role: uniform replacement of P by P' in a formula
notes: Same reading as T(P') in def:p02-beth-definability, applied to single formulas.
